notes.title: Early Access v1.2.0.2 Performance Improvements
notes.notes:
Lots of performance improvements in this update! This ought to help with larger towns. There are some game balance changes as well. Most notably Animal item drops have been turned up. 
The new game menu has been reconfigured as well. Now, when you hover your cursor over the map, you can see information about what you are looking at.

Lots of work is still needed to get the performance to where it needs to be for the full release, but this update is a big step towards that goal

Game Balance:
	Increased the droprate of Animal Pelts
	Increased the drop rate of Milk
	Increased the drop rate of Eggs
	Increased the drop rate of Wool
        Increased the number of Rabbits that can be in an Animal Pen

Performance:
	Made some improvements to Collectable objects placement
	Made some optimizations to Object pools to improve memory performance
	Reduced the poly counts for crops
        Reduced the poly counts for citizens
	Made improvements to the Pathfinding Algorithm
	Made improvements to Pathfinder movement
        Adjusted the UI blur shader to increase performance
        Texture sizes have been decreased
        Lots of miscellaneous improvements

Bug Fixes:
	Made some changes to Trading Posts and Train Stations to improve their ability to craft vehicles
	Fixed the FPS Counter so that it shows the correct value
	Fixed a bug where the window header tooltip remains after the window has been closed

Misc.
	Adjusted the lighting settings so that the game is brighter
        Lots of changes to the lighting to increase performance and make the game look nicer
	The game will now will work with low resolution displays
	Made the maple trees bigger
	Updated the descriptions for resource nodes
        Updated the terrain level descriptions
        When a new Technology has been selected, if the Town Center has the items required to research      
        it it will be researched automatically
        Moved the confine cursor option from Display Options to Game Options 

UI:
	The new game has been reconfigured to be more intuitive and informative
		You can now hover over the map to see information about what you are looking at

notes.title: Early Access v1.1.0.3 Minor Update
notes.notes:
Introducing the first Minor Update for Wildwood!

First of all you can expect to see some performance improvements. While the performance is better, a lot of work still needs to be done before the full release. In the meantime, this will hopefully help some of you that have been struggling. There are some changes you can make in the settings that should also help. First, I have added an option to change the Window Mode, running the game in Exclusive Fullscreen tends to yield better performance. Another thing you can do is adjust the LOD scale and the grass detail. Turning these down should increase the frame rate.

I have also made some changes to some of the early game mechanics to hopefully make the game more intuitive and fun. First of all I’ve changed some things about the UI to hopefully make the existence of the Tech Tree more obvious. The spawn rate of citizens has also been increased in the early game, to speed things up and keep the player from feeling like they are stuck waiting for more citizens. Several other changes have also been made to the game balance, however, the overall effect on the gameplay shouldn’t be too dramatic. Some things did need to be readjusted in the Tech Tree, so you might notice some Techs have moved around. When starting a new game you should also notice a lot more Stone Deposits. Having stone nearby is an important early game requirement so hopefully players won’t have to travel to find it.

Many other changes have been made that you can find in the patch notes below. Be sure to follow Wildwood and Thermal Expansion games on social media for more updates! 

I want to thank those of you that have already given your feedback on the game. A lot of the changes below are a direct result of that feedback. I really want to get as much feedback as possible to make Wildwood as great as it can be. The Wildwood Steam Community page is a great place give that feedback, as I almost always have that page open while I am working. If you find a bug be sure to submit a bug report! Make sure to include as many details as possible on how you found the bug, so that I can track it down and get it fixed quickly.

Thank you,
Ben


[b]Game Balance:[/b]
Changed the crafting recipe for Leather Strips from 1 Leather -> 2 Leather Strips to 1 Leather -> 3 Leather Strips
Changed the crafting recipe for Stone Tools from 2 Stone Bricks -> 1 Stone Tool to 1 Leather Strip, 1 Wood Plank, 1 Stone Brick -> 1 Stone Tool
Increased the time required to catch Lobster
Slightly increased the time required to catch Fish
Slightly Increased the drop rate for animals in a pen
Adjusted the algorithm for resource node spawning:
	Increased the Stone Deposit spawn rate
	Decreased the Iron Deposit Spawn rate 
	Decreased the Coal Deposit Spawn Rate
Increased the Citizen spawning rates during the early game.
Adjusted the upgrade and build cost for the Train Station

[b]Tech tree changes:[/b]
Moved Leather Strips to an earlier position in the tech tree
The Simple Train engine has been added as an unlock and has is unlocked after unlocking steel
The Train Station is now unlocked before unlocking Steel. This will allow the player to start placing their tracks while they are working on unlocking the Simple Train Engine
The Gatherer Tech now requires Mushrooms instead of Cabbages to unlock
Orange Juice is now unlocked when the Bistro unlocks

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Fixed a bug where animals in a pen would wander off
Fixed a bug where the Workplace Window wouldn’t update when a new workplace had been built
Performance Improvements:
	Reduced poly count of all the crops
Reduced the texture size of all the crops
	Reduced poly count of all the trees
Adjusted the material for the animals to be simpler
Made some changes to the UI that should improve performance
Made some changes to the pathfinders to improve performance

[b]Options Menu Changes:[/b]
Added an option to adjust the Window Mode. By default this is set to Exclusive Fullscreen. Exclusive Fullscreen tends to yield better performance
Added an option to adjust the display resolution
Added an option to Confine the Cursor to the game window
Changed default Hide UI input from [LALT] to [RALT]

[b]UI:[/b]
Changed the follow icon to a magnifying glass, adjusted the description of the tooltip as well

[b]Misc:[/b]
Trains and wagons now stop for a random time between 5 and 15 seconds instead of just 10 seconds. This will reduce the chance that they will travel on top of each other
Made some changes that should make Tech Tree more obvious to new players
Changed track rotation to use the rotate input ([R] by default) instead of right click. Should eliminate any chance of the player accidentally rotating the track while navigating the world.
Moved the version number on the main menu to above the social media icons

[b]Changed how version numbers work[/b]
	v1 - Major update
	.1 - Minor Update that has been pushed to the Default branch
	.0 - Update that has been pushed to the Beta Branch. This branch can be skipped if I feel the changes made in the alpha branch don’t need to be tested in the beta branch
	.3 - Update that has been pushed to the Alpha Branch. This branch definitely has bugs, but if you want to help contribute to the development of Wildwood this is the branch to be in

[b]Known issues:[/b]
Loading trains can cause the game to hang
Please submit bug reports as you find them! Be sure to include as many details as possible so that I can track them down and get them fixed
